en.bdb: Gurmat, association with saint  the count of nine  -

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੈ ਨਵੈ ਦੁਆਰ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: nau parakaaree bhagat kar saadhai navai dhuaar gurmatee|

en.bdb: People adopt ninefold devotion but the gurmukh while adopting the wisdom of Guru accomplishes the nine doors.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਚਖਾਇਆ ਗਾਵੈ ਜੀਭ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਰਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh piram chakhaiaa gaavai jeebh rasain ratee|

en.bdb: Tasting the joy of love, the Gurmukh with full attachment, recites the praises of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਵੀ ਖੰਡੀ ਜਾਣਾਇਆ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਸਤੀ ਅਸਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: navee kha(n)ddee jaanaiaa raaj jog jin satee asatee|

en.bdb: Through Rajyoga, the gurmukh has conquered both the truth and the falsehood and thus he is known all over the nine regions of the earth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਕਰਿ ਨਉ ਘਰ ਸਾਧਿਆ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਪਰਲਉ ਉਤਪਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: nau kar nau ghar saadhiaa varatamaan paralau utapatee|

en.bdb: Becoming humble he has disciplined the nine doors and besides he has diffused himself in creation and dissolution.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧੀ ਪਿਛ ਲਗਣੀ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਜੁਗਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: nav nidhee pichh laganee naath anaath sanaath jugatee|

en.bdb: The nine treasures follow him earnestly and the gurmukh unfolds to the nine naths, the technique of getting liberated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਉਖਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਖਲੀ ਮਿਠੀ ਕਉੜੀ ਠੰਢੀ ਤਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: nau ukhal vich ukhalee miThee kauRee Tha(n)ddee tatee|

en.bdb: Among the nine sockets (in the humanbody), the tongue which was bitter, sweet, hot and cool, now
Due to the association with the holy congregation and the wisdom of Guru, has become blest and full of delights.
